# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (May 6, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant activity in addressing flaky tests, particularly in fault proofs and challenger responses, with fixes proposed and implemented. Progress was also made on Proxyd enhancements and addressing gas accounting issues.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Proxyd Enhancements for Readiness and Block Capping
New features were introduced to Proxyd, including a `/readyz` endpoint for consensus readiness and capping the latest block at the cross-unsafe block.
- [#619](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/619)
- [#618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/618)

### Addressing Flaky Fault Proof Tests
A critical flaky test related to varied block times in pre-interop fault proofs was identified and a fix was submitted. The root cause involved batcher stopping logic and timestamp calculations.
- [#19804](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19804)

### Investigating Gas Accounting and EVM Discrepancies
Efforts are underway to improve documentation around gas accounting edge cases and to experiment with global `isolate = true` settings in Foundry to identify potential issues.
- [#20388](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20388)

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Proxyd Readiness and Block Capping:** A new feature to add a `/readyz` endpoint to Proxyd, gated on consensus readiness, was opened. Additionally, a pull request to cap the latest block at the cross-unsafe block in Proxyd was also opened.
    - [#619](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/619)
    - [#618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/618)

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Proxyd-CL Deployment and Healthcheck Fixes
The Proxyd-CL for production Mainnet was successfully deployed. Additionally, an issue regarding healthchecks on `/chain-id/` subdomains for OP-Supernode Charts was resolved, confirming functionality.
- [#20573](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20573)
- [#18451](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18451)

## NEW ISSUES
- **Flaky Challenger Test:** A new flaky test, `TestChallengerRespondsToMultipleInvalidClaims`, was reported in `op-acceptance-tests`.
    - [#20574](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20574)

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: TestPreinteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes ([#19804](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19804))
This flaky test was re-opened after flaking again with a different root cause. The issue stems from `freezeChains` stopping sequencers and batchers in parallel, leading to `LocalSafe` lagging behind `LocalUnsafe`. This can cause `startTimestamp` to be less than the current unsafe head's timestamp, tripping an assertion. A fix has been submitted to reorder `freezeChains` to ensure `LocalSafe == LocalUnsafe` before stopping batchers.

### interop + batcher: Use Verification-Aware CurrentL1 ([#19944](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19944))
This issue highlights that the Batcher's `CurrentL1` view, when fetching from the Virtual Node, may revert on reorgs. The issue is currently queued behind more immediate sync issues on devnets and is considered at risk for its end-of-month timeline. A relevant ticket in the `optimism` repository has been linked.

### [M4] kona-node: Light CL: Further Testing and Fixes ([#18800](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18800))
This ticket outlines further testing and fixes for the Kona node's light CL. It's noted that while this ticket points to valid bugs that still need addressing, it does not block the initial launch of interop.

### [L2CM retro] Go vs. EVM and Gas Accounting issues ([#20388](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20388))
Progress has been made on both items in this issue. For better documentation, a draft PR ([#20570](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20570)) has been opened to add a "Gas Accounting in Tests" subsection to the style guide. For applying `forge-config: default.isolate = true` globally, an experimental draft PR ([#20572](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20572)) has been opened to test what breaks in CI, with the goal of informing a decision on global vs. per-test isolation.

### OPCM.migrate: Ensure SystemConfig is updated with new addresses ([#20511](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20511))
This issue focuses on ensuring that the `SystemConfig` for both chains is updated with new shared addresses during OPCM migration, specifically checking `delayedWeth()`. A fix for this has been put up.

### Add unsafe head executing message validation ([#20553](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20553))
The current work-in-progress involves updating Proxyd to query 'cross-unsafe' from the interop filter and limit the head to this cross-unsafe block. Future tasks include making the failsafe optional and adding reorg support to the interop filter.

### flaky test: `TestChallengerRespondsToMultipleInvalidClaims` ([#20574](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20574))
A fix has been opened ([#20575](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20575)) for this flaky test. The root cause was identified as a `GameAlreadyExists` revert due to the synthetic honest root claim being identical to a canonical super root when the test's `safeTimestamp()` collides with a proposer's already used value. The fix introduces a `presets.WithoutHonestProposer()` option to prevent proposer races during game creation.
